n78d9140b12.headline: Eurozone Inflation Eases In March As Tariff Threat Looms
n78d9140b12.summary: Eurozone inflation slowed further in March, official data showed, potentially giving policymakers room despite turbulence from US trade tariffs.
n78d9140b12.why: Eurozone inflation data shapes European Central Bank rate expectations, which affect bond yields, the euro and equity valuations across the region.

na2723ea8d4.headline: South Africa plans US meeting on looming auto tariffs
na2723ea8d4.summary: South Africa will seek a meeting with US authorities on auto tariffs, Trade Minister Parks Tau said, noting the levies are a concern given preferential trade arrangements.
na2723ea8d4.why: South Africa's auto sector is a significant export industry, so changes in US tariffs affect its manufacturers and trade balance.

n8e4ac3df77.headline: Nigeria's foreign reserves dropped by $2.55bn in Q1 2025
n8e4ac3df77.summary: Nigeria's foreign reserves depreciated by $2.55 billion in the first quarter of 2025. Analysis showed the decline was the largest for a first quarter in the last five years.
n8e4ac3df77.why: Foreign exchange reserves help a central bank defend its currency and meet external obligations, so reserve declines are closely watched by investors in Nigerian assets.

n3e2049f890.headline: Britain hopeful US tariffs will be reversed with economic deal
n3e2049f890.summary: Britain remains hopeful that US tariffs will be reversed shortly if both sides agree the outline of a new economic partnership, its business minister said.
n3e2049f890.why: US tariffs on UK exports affect British manufacturers and services firms, so trade talks shape their export outlook.

n90f631abfe.headline: New Russian Offensive In Ukraine Looms
n90f631abfe.summary: Russia is increasing the pace of attacks in eastern Ukraine ahead of what Ukrainian officials and analysts believe will be a major new offensive.
n90f631abfe.why: Military escalation in Ukraine affects energy, grain and defence markets, and shapes sanctions and reconstruction policy.

nec698f0f8a.headline: What U.S. tariffs look like from a Chinese trade city
nec698f0f8a.summary: NPR reporting from a Chinese trade city examines how manufacturers there are handling US tariffs. The piece looks at how producers of goods sold to American consumers are adapting.
nec698f0f8a.why: US tariffs on Chinese goods raise import costs for American buyers and change sourcing decisions for global manufacturers.

n4adf61a400.headline: Spain continues to wage war on tourists as new law comes in
n4adf61a400.summary: Spain has introduced a new law clamping down on tourist lets, ahead of planned protests by local residents. The rules target short-term rental accommodation.
n4adf61a400.why: Regulation of short-term rentals affects property income, hotel and tourism demand, and the broader housing market in tourist destinations.

n3916c49587.headline: Kiev receives 3.5 bln euro tranche from Brussels
n3916c49587.summary: Ukraine has received a 3.5 billion euro tranche from Brussels, according to Denis Shmygal. Total financial assistance under the program has reached 19.6 billion euros.
n3916c49587.why: EU disbursements under the Ukraine support program fund the Ukrainian state budget and affect its macro-financial stability.

n640720e13b.headline: Select Fashion ‘collapses, leaving staff without pay’
n640720e13b.summary: Insolvency firm Moorfields has reportedly launched a wind-down of the womenswear chain Select Fashion, leaving staff without pay.
n640720e13b.why: Select Fashion is a UK womenswear retailer, and insolvencies in retail affect suppliers, landlords and employees. Store closures are a common signal of pressure in the high-street clothing sector.

nd5a432e134.headline: European Union Issues Grim Warning Over Trump’s Looming Tariffs
nd5a432e134.summary: The European Union says it is ready to put up a fight against US President Donald Trump over his planned tariffs.
nd5a432e134.why: The EU is the largest trading bloc in the world, and US tariffs on European goods affect exporters, supply chains and trade flows across many sectors.

n468e02d3cd.headline: Check for unclaimed money or savings to help with rising bills this month
n468e02d3cd.summary: Council Tax, energy bills, broadband, mobile phones and TV licences are all rising this month, prompting advice to check for unclaimed money.
n468e02d3cd.why: Household bills shape consumer spending and inflation in the UK, which influences Bank of England policy and retail and utility company earnings.

n12e135c593.headline: NEITI plans review of $6.03bn divestments by IOCs
n12e135c593.summary: Nigeria's NEITI has announced a review of divestments involving 26 oil blocks worth $6.03 billion by five international oil companies.
n12e135c593.why: Oil block divestments change which companies control upstream production, affecting investment and revenue in Nigeria's oil sector.

n3d9cc6044b.headline: Majority of Australians say financial situation stagnant or declining ahead of general election - 2LT News
n3d9cc6044b.summary: A survey released on the third day of Australia's general election campaign found most respondents say their financial situation has not improved over the last 12 months. The findings were reported by Xinhua.
n3d9cc6044b.why: Household financial sentiment influences consumer spending, which makes up a large share of Australia's economic activity.

n417f9be254.headline: Why Nigerian Govt shouldn't ban solar panel imports — CPPE
n417f9be254.summary: The Centre for the Promotion of Private Enterprise said the government's proposed ban on solar panel imports would worsen conditions for businesses. The group urged the government not to proceed with the ban.
n417f9be254.why: Import restrictions on solar equipment affect the cost of renewable energy projects and the competitiveness of local installers.

ne31b073f52.headline: Nigeria’s net FX reserves surged to $23.11bn in 2024 – CBN
ne31b073f52.summary: Nigeria's net foreign exchange reserves rose significantly to $23.11bn at the end of 2024, the highest level in more than three years, according to the central bank.
ne31b073f52.why: Foreign exchange reserves underpin a central bank's ability to defend its currency and meet external obligations, which matters for naira-denominated assets.

n565057f974.headline: Naira-for-petroleum deal fails
n565057f974.summary: Punch Newspapers reports the naira-for-petroleum deal has failed, with commentary blaming parts of Nigeria's petroleum sector for working against it.
n565057f974.why: Naira-for-petroleum arrangements affect how Nigeria's crude exports are paid for and how much foreign currency is supplied to local markets.

n3c69a2f66f.headline: France’s Marine Le Pen convicted of graft, barred from running for president in 2027
n3c69a2f66f.summary: French far-right leader Marine Le Pen was convicted of graft and barred from running for president in 2027. She said she will appeal, describing the ruling as politicised.
n3c69a2f66f.why: Marine Le Pen leads France's National Rally, and the political outlook affects French bonds, the euro and broader eurozone risk sentiment ahead of elections.

nc6e3e5767a.headline: Local elections to watch today. And, concerns over Trump's 'Liberation Day' tariffs
nc6e3e5767a.summary: Trump is expected to announce new tariffs, known as Liberation Day tariffs, which worry investors. The announcement is due the following day.
nc6e3e5767a.why: Broad US tariff announcements affect global trade flows, corporate margins and market risk sentiment. Investors reprice exposure to trade-sensitive sectors ahead of them.

nbfd15fc507.headline: Crypto firm Circle appoints JPMorgan and Citi to gear up for IPO
nbfd15fc507.summary: Crypto firm Circle has appointed JPMorgan and Citi to prepare for its IPO. It intends to make its IPO paperwork public by late April, though no definitive date is set.
nbfd15fc507.why: Circle is the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, so its listing is a closely watched test of appetite for crypto-linked public offerings.

n6ad2b16955.headline: What is Trump’s so-called April 2 ‘Liberation Day’? - The Boston Globe
n6ad2b16955.summary: Trump has repeatedly called April 2 'Liberation Day', with promises to roll out a set of tariffs on imports from other countries. The explainer outlines the planned tariff measures.
n6ad2b16955.why: Broad tariffs on imports change trade costs across global supply chains, affecting exporters, importers and inflation expectations.

n84a4be6bd9.headline: Stock market update: Stocks that hit 52-week lows on NSE in today
n84a4be6bd9.summary: HCL Tech, Bajaj Finserv, HDFC Bank, BEL and Shriram Finance were among the top losers on the NSE, according to the day's market update.
n84a4be6bd9.why: The National Stock Exchange of India is the country's largest exchange by trading volume, and 52-week lows signal sustained selling in these shares.

n1d4c452c53.headline: RBI to focus on better customer service and protection, says governor Malhotra | Mint
n1d4c452c53.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will seek to optimise its regulatory frameworks while balancing financial stability and efficiency, governor Malhotra said.
n1d4c452c53.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank that sets monetary policy and oversees the banking system for India's economy.

nc358a2389f.headline: Managing Trump, tariffs looms large in bid for votes
nc358a2389f.summary: Australia's political leaders have said biosecurity and medicines are not up for debate as they respond to US tariffs. The tariffs are described as set to take effect.
nc358a2389f.why: Trade negotiations involving pharmaceuticals and agricultural biosecurity rules affect Australian exporters and importers.

n168b7cfd33.headline: Bollywood film that earned just  ₹65 lakh destroys  ₹3,500 crore upcoming IPO; Here's how | Stock Market News
n168b7cfd33.summary: Indira IVF has halted its ₹3,500 crore IPO after the regulator SEBI questioned the timing of the film 'Tumko Meri Kasam', which appeared to endorse the company. The film underperformed at the box office.
n168b7cfd33.why: SEBI is India's securities regulator, and its scrutiny of IPO disclosures and promotion can delay or derail listings.

na6e97e9bf6.headline: UniCredit secures ECB, Bank of Italy nod for Banco BPM bid
na6e97e9bf6.summary: UniCredit has secured authorisations from the European Central Bank and Bank of Italy for its bid for Banco BPM. The approvals are the final step before Consob completes its review of the offer document.
na6e97e9bf6.why: UniCredit is a large pan-European bank and Banco BPM is a major Italian lender, so the bid shapes consolidation in Italian banking.

impacts.name: UniCredit
impacts.why: UniCredit is the bidder and must complete the offer after regulatory approval.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n90ce64c297.headline: Upcoming IPO: ESDS Software Solution refiles DRHP for  ₹600 crore public offer | Stock Market News
n90ce64c297.summary: ESDS Software Solutions refiled its draft papers for a Rs 600 crore public offer. Proceeds are planned to enhance its cloud services and infrastructure, with 75% reserved for QIBs.
n90ce64c297.why: An IPO lets a company raise public capital and gives investors a new listing. ESDS is an Indian cloud and data center services provider.

n7a5f46848f.headline: North India healthcare chain Park Hospitals files DRHP for IPO
n7a5f46848f.summary: Park Medi World Pvt Ltd, a New Delhi-headquartered multi-speciality hospital chain, has filed its draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering.
n7a5f46848f.why: A draft red herring prospectus is the regulatory filing a company submits to India's market regulator before listing shares, so it signals a planned public share sale.

n4ab2fd189d.headline: Stock market update: Nifty Pharma index  falls  1.73%
n4ab2fd189d.summary: The Nifty Pharma index closed 1.73 per cent lower at 20771.8 in Indian trading.
n4ab2fd189d.why: The Nifty Pharma index tracks the pharmaceutical stocks listed on India's National Stock Exchange, a sector important to Indian exporters and generic-drug makers.

n07d920c570.headline: Australian Market Significantly Higher
n07d920c570.summary: The Australian stock market is trading significantly higher on Tuesday, reversing the previous session's losses. The move followed mixed cues from Wall Street overnight.
n07d920c570.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index and covers the largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local and global risk sentiment.
n07d920c570.why_moved: The index is rebounding after the previous session's losses, following mixed overnight cues from Wall Street. The input gives no further reason.

n942a082615.headline: How Finland has replaced coal power with wind in less than 10 years
n942a082615.summary: Wind power in Finland has more than doubled since 2020 and now supplies a quarter of the country's energy. The growth has helped replace coal-fired generation.
n942a082615.why: Wind generation shifts electricity pricing, fuel demand and investment in power infrastructure. Nordic energy transition trends affect utilities and equipment makers.

n9701bde063.headline: Japan PMI manufacturing finalized at 48.4, weaker domestic and international demand
n9701bde063.summary: Japan's final manufacturing PMI fell to 48.4 in March from 49.0 in February, marking the lowest level in a year. Weaker domestic and international demand weighed on the sector.
n9701bde063.why: The PMI is a monthly survey of purchasing managers, and readings below 50 signal contraction in factory activity, a key gauge for Japan's economy.

ne709398aae.headline: The judge could avoid the ineligibility of Le Pen. But he wanted to stop it
ne709398aae.summary: A French court sentenced Marine Le Pen to four years in prison, two of them conditional, plus a €100,000 fine and five years of ineligibility. The ruling affects her eligibility to run for office.
ne709398aae.why: Marine Le Pen leads the National Rally, a major French party, so her eligibility shapes expectations for French political and fiscal policy.

n1c794a3278.headline: Hahn & Co. expands semiconductor portfolio with W2.6tr SK Specialty deal
n1c794a3278.summary: Hahn & Co., a South Korean private equity firm, has completed its acquisition of SK Specialty from SK Group for 2.6 trillion won, expanding its semiconductor portfolio.
n1c794a3278.why: Private equity deals for chemical and materials units reshape ownership in the semiconductor supply chain and the corporate structure of Korean conglomerates.

n1188913805.headline: Liberal Leader Mark Carney pitches affordability measures as U.S. readies new tariffs
n1188913805.summary: Liberal Leader Mark Carney shifted his campaign to affordability, one day before U.S. President Donald Trump is expected to impose wide-ranging tariffs on several countries including Canada.
n1188913805.why: Tariff measures on Canada affect trade flows, input costs and the Canadian dollar, shaping investor views on Canadian growth.

n40ba183ca8.headline: Maine farmers voice concerns over more tariffs
n40ba183ca8.summary: Many Maine farmers rely on Canada for fertilizer and organic grain. They voiced concern over proposed additional tariffs.
n40ba183ca8.why: Tariffs on fertilizer and grain raise farm input costs and can cut farm margins in the U.S. agricultural sector.

n46bbd3fc00.headline: ‘This is a big concern’: New York tourism official worried about drop in Canadian visitors
n46bbd3fc00.summary: Western New York tourism officials are worried after data showed cross-border visits from Canadians fell significantly in February amid the trade war.
n46bbd3fc00.why: Cross-border tourism generates spending on hotels, restaurants and retail in border regions. Shifts in visitor flows affect local tourism revenue.

n02c910ddde.headline: GTA gas prices plunge by 20 cents per litre. Here is where they could go from here
n02c910ddde.summary: Gas prices in the Greater Toronto Area dropped about 20 cents per litre following the elimination of the consumer carbon tax as of April 1.
n02c910ddde.why: Fuel taxes and carbon levies are a major component of retail gasoline prices. Changes to them shift consumer fuel costs and inflation measures.

n7e63a2583c.headline: There is a truckload of trouble coming as the budget looms and the signals are ominous.
n7e63a2583c.summary: The government intends to remove the Living Wage requirement from procurement contracts, affecting labor costs and public sector expenses.
n7e63a2583c.why: Changes in procurement policies can influence government spending, labor costs, and economic activity in affected sectors.

n951c61c964.headline: Ostium Launches Competitive Points Program for Trading Activity and Liquidity Provision
n951c61c964.summary: Ostium, a leveraged trading platform for real-world assets, announced a new points program to boost trading and liquidity.
n951c61c964.why: The platform's new program aims to attract traders and liquidity providers, impacting trading volumes and platform competitiveness.

ne846708757.headline: ‘America first’ trade war policy has the entire stock and Bitcoin market under anxiety
ne846708757.summary: Markets react to potential tariffs, with Bitcoin falling 4.54%, reflecting investor uncertainty amid US trade tensions.
ne846708757.why: Trade policies and tariffs directly affect market sentiment, currency, and crypto valuations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Trade tensions increase risk aversion, impacting crypto markets.

nc6510d27fe.headline: Korean won falls further to below 1,470 won, lowest in 16 years
nc6510d27fe.summary: The South Korean won weakened further against the US dollar, reaching its lowest level in 16 years, amid US dollar strength and global market pressures.
nc6510d27fe.why: Currency movements affect trade competitiveness, inflation, and capital flows in South Korea.

n5baad3a3d6.headline: Why is China angry about a plan to sell two ports on the Panama Canal?
n5baad3a3d6.summary: China is displeased with plans to sell two ports on the Panama Canal, highlighting a tightening business environment in Hong Kong and geopolitical tensions.
n5baad3a3d6.why: Port ownership and control are critical for global trade routes; disputes can affect shipping, logistics, and geopolitical relations.
